inventions.title: Dynamic IUL Illustration Compliance Engine
inventions.description: Auto-generates AG49-compliant illustrations while maximizing persuasive impact within regulatory bounds

inventions.title: Multi-Carrier IUL Comparison Optimizer
inventions.description: Normalizes disparate carrier illustration formats into unified comparison framework with standardized metrics

inventions.title: Automated Policy Review & Replacement Analyzer
inventions.description: Evaluates existing life insurance policies against replacement options with 1035 exchange optimization

inventions.title: Premium Financing Arbitrage Calculator
inventions.description: Models leveraged IUL strategies using bank financing with dynamic interest rate scenarios

inventions.title: Living Benefits Probability Engine
inventions.description: Calculates probability-weighted value of chronic/critical/terminal illness riders across demographics

inventions.title: Disability Insurance Gap Analyzer (DIGA)
inventions.description: Occupation-specific disability probability modeling across 25 occupation categories with multi-policy coordination across group, individual, and IUL living benefit riders; identifies income replacement, benefit period, and definition-of-disability gaps on an after-tax basis

inventions.title: Key Person Insurance Valuation Engine for Medical Practices (KPIVE)
inventions.description: Revenue attribution across five factors, replacement cost estimation over a 6-18 month timeline, and cascading business continuity impact modeling that reveals practice valuation declines of 2-3x a lost physician's direct revenue

inventions.title: IUL Policy Loan Optimization Engine (IPLOE)
inventions.description: Variable rate hedging against indexed crediting cycles, wash loan arbitrage detection, and multi-policy loan coordination including cross-policy moves that borrow from a wash-provision policy to fund premium on a higher-crediting policy

inventions.title: Indexed Annuity + IUL Hybrid Income Floor Engine (IAIUL)
inventions.description: Guaranteed income layering sized backward from essential expenses, upside capture above the floor through capped-and-floored indexed crediting, and three-phase tax-diversified distribution sequencing that offsets RMDs with tax-free loans

inventions.title: Real-Time Tax Code Change Impact Simulator
inventions.description: Models proposed tax legislation impact on client portfolios before laws are enacted

inventions.title: Multi-Entity Tax Optimization Router
inventions.description: Routes income through optimal entity structures (S-Corp, C-Corp, LLC, trust) to minimize aggregate tax

inventions.title: Charitable Remainder Trust + IUL Wealth Replacement Calculator
inventions.description: Models CRT income streams with IUL death benefit replacement for estate tax elimination

inventions.title: Opportunity Zone + IUL Capital Gains Deferral Engine
inventions.description: Combines QOZ investments with IUL for double tax deferral and permanent exclusion strategies

inventions.title: State Tax Arbitrage Migration Planner
inventions.description: Models net financial benefit of state residency changes considering all tax types, cost of living, and estate implications

inventions.title: 1031 Exchange Chain Optimization Engine (1031COE)
inventions.description: Multi-property exchange sequence planning across 5-20 properties, 45/180-day deadline compliance monitoring, and IRC 1014 basis step-up coordination that converts deferred gain into permanently eliminated gain

inventions.title: Physician Loan Refinancing Optimizer (PLRO)
inventions.description: PSLF net present value carrying compounded program-continuation, employment-continuity and certification risk, plus IUL cash value pledged as refinancing collateral for a 25-75bp rate reduction and the reinforcing cash-flow cycle it creates

inventions.title: Gamified Financial Literacy Platform
inventions.description: Turns financial education into achievement-based game with levels, badges, and real portfolio impact scores

inventions.title: Predictive Client Churn Prevention System
inventions.description: ML model predicting client departure probability based on engagement patterns, life events, and market conditions

inventions.title: Automated Life Event Detection & Response Engine
inventions.description: Monitors public records, social media, and client data for life events (marriage, birth, job change) triggering proactive advisor outreach

inventions.title: Client Family Tree Financial Mapping
inventions.description: Maps multi-generational family financial relationships for estate planning and wealth transfer optimization

inventions.title: Voice-Activated Financial Dashboard
inventions.description: Natural language interface for advisors to query client data, run calculations, and generate reports hands-free

inventions.title: AI-Powered Compliance Pre-Check System
inventions.description: Scans advisor communications and recommendations for compliance violations before they occur

inventions.title: Automated Succession Planning Valuation Engine
inventions.description: Values advisor practices using revenue multiples, client demographics, and retention probability models

inventions.title: Dynamic Commission Optimization Router
inventions.description: Models product placement across carriers to maximize advisor compensation while maintaining client suitability

inventions.title: Peer Benchmarking Intelligence Network
inventions.description: Anonymous advisor performance benchmarking across practice size, specialty, and geography

inventions.title: Automated CE Credit Tracker & Recommendation Engine
inventions.description: Tracks continuing education requirements across states and licenses, recommends optimal CE courses

inventions.title: Practice Acquisition Due Diligence Automation Engine (PADDA)
inventions.description: 15-dimension client book quality scoring, revenue sustainability projection under new ownership, and five-dimension integration risk assessment that corrects standard revenue-multiple valuations by 15-30%

inventions.title: Quantum-Resistant Portfolio Stress Testing
inventions.description: Stress tests portfolios against extreme tail-risk scenarios using fat-tailed distributions and regime-switching models

inventions.title: Blockchain-Verified Financial Plan Audit Trail
inventions.description: Immutable record of all financial recommendations, calculations, and client approvals for regulatory compliance

inventions.title: Real-Time Market Sentiment Integration for IUL Crediting
inventions.description: Incorporates market sentiment indicators into IUL crediting rate predictions for more accurate projections

inventions.title: Multi-Currency Wealth Optimization for International Clients
inventions.description: Models currency risk, international tax treaties, and cross-border estate planning for HNW international clients

inventions.title: Automated Annuity Comparison with Hidden Fee Detection
inventions.description: Reverse-engineers annuity contracts to expose all embedded fees, surrender charges, and MVA risks

inventions.title: Multi-Generational Wealth Transfer Simulation Engine (MGWTSE)
inventions.description: Dynasty trust modeling with trustee succession scenarios, GST exemption allocation optimization, and 100-year four-generation wealth trajectory projection under three tax-law scenarios

inventions.title: Regulatory Sandbox Simulation Environment
inventions.description: Allows advisors to test financial strategies in a simulated regulatory environment before implementing with real clients

inventions.title: Client Digital Twin Financial Modeling
inventions.description: Creates a complete digital twin of client financial life for scenario testing without affecting real accounts
